style_residual.note_directory_scope: sweep3.py is run PER DIRECTORY (docs/recipes, then docs/reference) and never as bare `docs`, because bare `docs` reports a pre-existing TOTAL edit in docs/operations/ at HEAD that does not belong to this phase's scope, and a single FILE path always reports a vacuous 0 files / 0 edits rather than genuinely scanning anything.
style_residual.note_blind_spots: sweep3.py skips every line starting with the pipe character, so it can never see a table cell, and it sets the em-dash rule off unconditionally, so D-28's tight-em-dash requirement for new docs/ strings has no instrument at all and is a hand ruling in 161-04 Task 6.
style_residual.note_files_field: sweep3.py's own printed 'N files' figure counts files it TOUCHED (edited), not files scanned; with TOTAL edits at 0 this figure is always 0 by construction and is not itself the vacuity signal. The nonzero 'protected (em dashes left alone)' counts below prove the directory was genuinely walked and its content genuinely evaluated, which is the actual anti-vacuity evidence for a directory target (contrast the single-FILE-path case, which reports 0 files AND 0 protected entries).
